5170-5231-6132-8292.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Massacre Girl triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent and causing you to gain 1 life
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Massacre Girl trigger.
Resolve the Massacre Girl trigger, dealing 1 damage to target opponent and causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1479-2841-2907-8100.easyPrerequisites:
(optional)You control an Elf or have an Elf card in hand. Your life total is 2 or higher.
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Elven Passage.
1479-2841-2907-8100.description:
Fetch a land using Elven Passage.
When the fetched land enters, Scute Swarm and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Scute Swarm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Scute Swarm trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Scute Swarm triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2738-4871-6112-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Fumulus, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Fumulus trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1.
Repeat.

500-1181-7487.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Zealous Lorecaster and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Zealous Lorecaster tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Saw in Half and Sacrifice from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Sacrifice by paying {B} and sacrificing a Zealous Lorecaster token, adding an amount of {B} equal to its mana value. 
Repeat.

4377-5144-6991.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Donnie & April and exiling Ephemerate.
When Donnie & April enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Donnie & April.
When Donnie & April enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Etali, Primal Conqueror // Etali, Primal Sickness

575-4294-5231-7115.description:
Cast Etali either from your hand or the command zone by paying {5}{R}{R} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Etali enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Etali.
When Etali dies, Yedora triggers, returning Etali from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Holding priority, activate Etali by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Etali trigger from step 2, exiling cards from the top of each library until each player has exiled a nonland card, and causing you to cast any number of those cards without paying its mana cost.
For each card cast, Toph's second ability triggers once.
Resolve the first Toph trigger, earthbending Etali.
Resolve any remaining triggers, earthbending any other lands you desire. If you do not want to earthbend other lands, target Etali with all remaining triggers.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Etali.
When Etali dies, Toph and Yedora trigger.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, choosing not to return Etali.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Etali from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat from step 2.

628-5147-7218.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Reaping Willow.
When Reaping Willow dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability
Repeat.

628-2292-7211.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Brambleback Brute.
When Brambleback Brute dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability
Repeat.

628-2292-7213.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Encumbered Reejerey.
When Encumbered Reejerey dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability
Repeat.

659-4381-4613-7060.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
659-4381-4613-7060.description:
Activate a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, creating a 1/1 red Goblin creature token.
The 1/1 Goblin token enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully's ability.
Repeat.

2034-3490-6719-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-3490-6719-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

147-3047-6798.description:
Cast Feign Death by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Feign Death, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Feign Death.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Umbral Collar Zealot abilities from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with a +1/+1 counter on it

1978-3990-5056.description:
Cause Incubation Druid to become an artifact using Neurok Transmuter.
Activate Incubation Druid by tapping it, adding three mana of any type a land you control can produce
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Incubation Druid.
Repeat from step 2.

1358-1978-6893.description:
Animate The Eternity Elevator using Sydri.
Activate The Eternity Elevator by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping The Eternity Elevator.
Repeat from step 2.
1358-1978-6893.notes: If The Eternity Elevator has twenty or more charge counters on it, you can instead use its second ability to get infinite colored mana. You can also use both interchangeably, if desired.

2511-2736-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 2.

560-1115-1563-2457.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

338-360-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-360-5641.description:
Gain life.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

3764-3967-4871.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Pincher creature token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the Pincher.
When the Pincher dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Summoning Station triggers, untapping it.
Repeat.

1447-1734-6446.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying {1}{W}{W}.
When Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Angel of Glory's Rise.
Activate Silvar by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Angel of Glory's Rise from exile to the battlefield.
When Angel of Glory's Rise enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

804-1479-3861.description:
Play Orzhov Basilica.
Kodama of the East Tree, Sakashima the Impostor, and Orzhov Basilica trigger.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Orzhov Basilica onto the battlefield.
Sakashima the Impostor and Orzhov Basilica trigger.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor token's trigger, putting Orzhov Basilica onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Orzhov Basilica trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

678-2034-4192-5659-5753.easyPrerequisites: "Lhurgoyf" chosen with Ashes of the Fallen.
678-2034-4192-5659-5753.description:
Discard Circling Vultures from your hand using its static ability.
Because Circling Vultures is a Lhurgoyf due to Ashes of the Fallen, Disa the Restless's first ability triggers, putting Circling Vultures from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Circling Vultures, adding {C}{C}.
When Circling Vultures dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Circling Vultures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1527-4772-4911.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls an indestructible creature, or you have a way to give an opponent's creature indestructible.
You control a number of artifacts greater than two times the indestructible creature's toughness.
1527-4772-4911.description:
Give an opponent's creature indestructible, if needed.
Activate Ghirapur Aether Grid by tapping two artifacts you control, dealing 1 damage to an indestructible creature an opponent controls.
If the creature has less than 0 toughness, Magmatic Galleon's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Repeat from step 2.

643-1849-3259-4302.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to any other creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
643-1849-3259-4302.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to any other creature you control, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the creature that had Breath of Fury attached dies as an Angel due to Maskwood Nexus, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Maskwood Nexus, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat each combat phase.

777-2034-3321-5220.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Filigree Familiar, adding {C}{C}.
When Filigree Familiar dies, its second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Filigree Familiar on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Filigree Familiar trigger, causing you to draw Filigree Familiar.
Cast Filigree Familiar by paying {2}.
When Filigree Familiar enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to gain two life.
Repeat.

275-1216-1799-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Sengir Autocrat, adding {R}.
When Sengir Autocrat leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, exiling all Serf tokens.
Activate Transplant Theorist by paying {2}, putting Sengir Autocrat on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Sengir Autocrat into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Sengir Autocrat enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating three 0/1 Serf creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod three times by sacrificing the Serfs, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1558-1692-3263-3667.notablePrerequisites:
Helm of the Host attached to Evangel of Heliod.
Your devotion to white is at least four.
1558-1692-3263-3667.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Evangel of Heliod with haste.
The Evangel of Heliod token enters the battlefield, creating a number of 1/1 Soldier creature tokens equal to your devotion to white.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five creature tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

225-2605-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
225-2605-4222.description:
Activate Lotus Vale by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Lotus Vale.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Repeat any number of times.
Repeat steps with a different color for infinite mana of any color.
